audit.why: Full sides and content win[0..6] both read Zed on all seven rows, matching the packet chart. Hwei has no dash in any of his three palettes, so no stage flips to him.
The spikes track the real curve: levels 3-5 poke war, level 6 Death Mark, first item deletion, and a late game where Hwei only stabilises by zoning at range.

audit.whatIsWrong: The matchup's focus ability is written throughout as 'Subject: Fear (CC Paints)'. There is no such ability. Hwei's crowd-control palette is Subject: Torment (E), containing Grim Visage, Gaze of the Abyss and Crushing Maw. The content spikes also invent 'Stirring Lantern' (really Stirring Lights), 'Pool of Everblazing' (really Pool of Reflection) and 'Crushing Maelstrom' (really Crushing Maw), and label Severing Bolt as an E-palette ability when it sits on Subject: Disaster. The page also never states Hwei's passive: a second damaging spell completes the signature, which is what actually kills you.
audit.why: Riot's own ability text lists the three palettes and their contents exactly. Signature of the Visionary primes on the first damaging spell and completes on the second.
audit.corrected: Every reachable field renamed to Subject: Torment with its real sub-abilities, the invented names replaced, and the two-spell signature written into the trade lines.

audit.why: Subject: Disaster 10/9/8/7/6, Subject: Serenity 18/17.5/17/16.5/16, Subject: Torment 12/11.5/11/10.5/10, Spiraling Despair 120/100/80, Living Shadow 20/19/18/17/16.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d was tradeGood verbatim and dontsFull[2].d was tradeBad verbatim, both under unrelated titles.
audit.corrected: Both rewritten to their titles and grounded in Hwei's kit.

edits.before: Chip the threshold, dodge the one answer, and let the mark notarize the lane. Track Subject: Fear (CC Paints) before every commit and keep the wave where your pattern works.
edits.after: Chip the threshold, dodge the one answer, and let the mark notarize the lane. Track Subject: Torment (CC Paints) before every commit and keep the wave where your pattern works.

edits.before: - Zed vs Hwei - Track: Hwei Subject: Fear (CC Paints). - Chip to 60% before any mark — the R is a calculator, not a coin. - Engage only on Subject: Fear (CC Paints)’s cooldown. - Spend your ultimate on kill windows only.
edits.after: - Zed vs Hwei - Track: Hwei Subject: Torment (CC Paints). - Chip to 60% before any mark — the R is a calculator, not a coin. - Engage only on Subject: Torment (CC Paints)’s cooldown. - Spend your ultimate on kill windows only.

edits.before: Hwei wins by landing Subject: Fear (CC Paints), denying your pattern, and renting you the lane at a range markup.
edits.after: Hwei wins by rooting you out of Subject: Torment, priming his signature, then completing it with a second paint.

edits.before: - Hwei Subject: Fear (CC Paints): matchup-defining — All his crowd control lives on the E palette — dodge the fear/root and the burst never chains. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget W Living Shadow (swap) for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Subject: Torment is 12s at rank 1 and 10s maxed — every piece of his crowd control lives on that palette, so dodge Grim Visage and the chain never starts. - Subject: Serenity shields on 18s and Spiraling Despair is 120s early. - Your 20s Living Shadow is the emergency swap.

edits.before: All his crowd control lives on the E palette — dodge the fear/root and the burst never chains. Its cooldown is the green light — wait for it.
edits.after: All his crowd control lives on Subject: Torment — dodge Grim Visage and the burst never chains. Its 12s cooldown is your green light.

edits.before: Hwei wastes Subject: Fear (CC Paints) — that is your full-commit window.
edits.after: Hwei spends Subject: Torment on the wave — that is your full-commit window.

edits.before: Carry through subpoenas — one marked carry per fight; your job is the threshold math and the swap you saved for their answer.
edits.after: Carry by taking Hwei off the board first — he owns no dash in any palette, and their zone control leaves with him.

edits.before: Ahead, audit the map: scissor Hwei off every contact, mark the thresholds, and roam the crashes — fed Zed makes health bars legal documents.
edits.after: Ahead, sit on his farm: with no dash he cannot escape a shadow-swap entry, so crash the wave, punish each paint, and roam while he clears.

edits.before: Track Hwei’s Subject: Fear (CC Paints): All his crowd control lives on the E palette — dodge the fear/root and the burst never chains. The whole green-light system is its cooldown.
edits.after: Track Hwei’s Subject: Torment: all his crowd control lives on that palette — dodge Grim Visage and Crushing Maw and the chain never starts. Its 12s cooldown is the whole green-light system.

edits.before: Commit on Subject: Fear (CC Paints)’s cooldown, on your first item spike, and with your jungler’s setup. His answer goes first; yours goes last.
edits.after: Commit on Subject: Torment’s 12s cooldown, on your first item spike, and with your jungler’s setup. His answer goes first; yours goes last.

edits.before: With Q-E-Q traded onto a Hwei who lacks a point-and-click escape, you own the poke war: shadow a wave, weave W-shadow Q to double-tap, and back off before he lines EW (Severing Bolt) on a slowed target. Hold your dash to dodge his QQ (Devastating Fire) telegraph rather than to engage.
edits.after: With Q-E-Q traded onto a Hwei who lacks a point-and-click escape, you own the poke war: shadow a wave, weave W-shadow Q to double-tap, and back off before he lines QW (Severing Bolt) on a slowed target. Hold your dash to dodge his QQ (Devastating Fire) telegraph rather than to engage.

edits.before: Death Mark turns every combo into a kill threat: land W behind him, R in, and drop Q+E+ignite so the mark detonates before his QE zone control resets. His only answer is WW (Stirring Lantern) shield or flashing the mark, so bait the shield first with a shadow Q.
edits.after: Death Mark turns every combo into a kill threat: land W behind him, R in, and drop Q+E+ignite so the mark detonates before his QE zone control resets. His only answer is the Subject: Serenity shield or flashing the mark, so bait the shield first with a shadow Q.

edits.before: Post-Eclipse/Youmuu you delete Hwei from 100 if he's out of WW shield; his QQ and EE (Pool of Everblazing) do not stop a well-timed R-swap. Look for the all-in the instant his QE (Crushing Maelstrom) knock-up is on cooldown.
edits.after: Post-Eclipse/Youmuu you delete Hwei from 100 once his Serenity shield is spent; his Disaster paints and Pool of Reflection do not stop a well-timed R-swap. Look for the all-in the instant Crushing Maw is on cooldown.

notes: 'Subject: Fear (CC Paints)' is a fabricated ability name and it appears in more fields than I edited — breakdown.feeding and report[1].t still carry it, and report[1] duplicates winCon. I stopped at two report rewrites per the sweep limit, so those two fields need a follow-up pass. I did not assert which Serenity sub-ability provides the shield (the kit tags the palette, not the individual paint), so the text says 'Subject: Serenity shield' rather than naming Pool of Reflection or Stirring Lights.
